## 🛠️ How Can You Contribute?

### 1. Reporting Bugs 🐛
Before creating a bug report, please check existing issues to avoid duplicates. When submitting a report, include:
- A clear, descriptive title.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- Expected vs actual behavior.
- Screenshots or error logs (if applicable).
- Your environment details (OS, Python/node version, etc.).

### 2. Suggesting Features 💡
Enhancement suggestions are tracked as GitHub Issues. Provide:
- A clear, detailed explanation of the proposed feature.
- Why this feature would be useful to Jarvis-AI users.
- Any implementation details or visual concepts you have in mind.

### 3. Submitting Pull Requests (PRs) 📥
Follow these steps to contribute code:

1. **Fork the Repository**  
   Click the **Fork** button at the top right of this page.

2. **Clone Your Fork**  
   ```bash
   git clone [https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/Jarvis-AI.git](https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/Jarvis-AI.git)
   cd Jarvis-AI
